_about: Index -> name of the EMBER2024 family/tag model outputs, RECONSTRUCTED by DocuTraceX (the authors did not publish the label maps), on 67,806 labelled EMBER2024 test files. Tags: output matched to the tag it ranks best (ROC AUC, mutual best); a tag is only shown when the model output reaches its 'threshold' (precision >= 'precision' on malicious files, firing on <= 'benign_fire' of benign files) — high = own threshold reaching precision >= 0.8 with <= 0.2% benign firing; medium = precision >= 0.5 at 0.5 with <= 0.5% benign firing; other tags are dropped. Family (v4, 2,462 of 2,538 outputs named): on 175,059 labelled EMBER2024 test + train files (6,776 families, up to 80 per family), each output named after the family whose files raise it most specifically (mean probability / overall mean, family and output each other's best); high = top-3 purity >= 0.6 with >= 5 files, medium = top-3 purity >= 0.35; outputs v4 could not name keep the v3 majority-vote name ('map': 'v3'). Rare families are less reliable than measured.

family.method: v3: top-1 vote of labelled EMBER2024 test files; v4 (CI, 175,059 labelled test+train files, 6,776 families): lift-based mutual best between family and output, confidence by top-3 purity
